content: pi-kit is a batteries-included extension package for the pi coding agent, installed via `pi install https://github.com/cwilson613/pi-kit`. Located at ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/cwilson613/pi-kit.
pi-kit provides 20 extensions, 6 skills, 4 prompt templates. Entry: package.json `pi.extensions` array. See ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/cwilson613/pi-kit/package.json for full manifest.

pi-kit project-memory extension: SQLite-backed (better-sqlite3), semantic search via Ollama qwen3-embedding, episodic session narratives, confidence decay, FTS5, cross-machine JSONL export. See extensions/project-memory/
project-memory stores facts in .pi/memory/facts.db (project) and ~/.pi/memory/global.db (cross-project). facts.jsonl is git-tracked for cross-machine sync.
pi-kit model-budget extension: defaults to claude-opus-4-6 on session start. `set_model_tier` tool switches between opus/sonnet/haiku. See extensions/model-budget.ts.

pi-kit offline-driver extension: registers Ollama models via pi.registerProvider() on session start; /offline and /online commands; preferred order: nemotron-3-nano:30b > devstral-small-2:24b > qwen3:30b.
pi-kit cleave extension: task decomposition with git worktrees under ~/.pi/cleave/wt/; OpenSpec integration when openspec/changes/*/tasks.md exists; complexity threshold 2.0. See extensions/cleave/
pi-kit web-search extension: providers Brave/Tavily/Serper via @secret annotations; modes quick/deep/compare; auto-selects tavily > serper > brave. See extensions/web-search/
pi-kit style/theme system: 'Verdant' dark palette — primary #3dc9b0, bg #0c0e12. Canonical tokens in themes/default.json; Excalidraw semantic palette in extensions/render/excalidraw/types.ts.

pi-kit secrets extension: 6 layers — resolve, output redact, tool guard, recipe store (~/.pi/agent/secrets.json), local-model scrub, audit log. Extensions declare secrets via @secret/@config annotations scanned at load time. See extensions/00-secrets/index.ts.
pi-kit has a bin/deploy script that commits, pushes, and hard-resets the installed copy at ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/cwilson613/pi-kit. See bin/deploy.
pi-kit distill extension: /distill command writes session distillation markdown to .pi/distillations/<timestamp>-<slug>.md. See extensions/distill.ts.
pi-kit session-log extension: auto-reads last 80 lines of .session_log on session_start; /session-log command appends structured entries. See extensions/session-log.ts.
pi-kit shared-state.ts uses Symbol.for('pi-kit-shared-state') on globalThis; currently carries memoryTokenEstimate (written by project-memory, read by status-bar).

pi-kit auto-compact fires at 70% (configurable AUTO_COMPACT_PERCENT); project-memory pressure gradient: onset 55%, warning 75%, auto-compact 85%. See extensions/auto-compact.ts and extensions/project-memory/types.ts.

project-memory context injection: semantic subset when embeddings available and >20 facts; otherwise full dump. Pressure gradient: onset 55%, warning 75%, auto-compaction at 85% (default). See extensions/project-memory/types.ts.

pi-kit auto-compact (70% turn_end) and project-memory (85% tool_execution_end) are layered: auto-compact is the trigger, project-memory provides resilience. Pressure gradient (55-75%) warns agent ahead of auto-compact threshold.
pi-kit AGENTS.md global directive: no Co-Authored-By AI attribution in commits. Work is not done until committed and pushed.
pi-kit model-budget extension calls switchTo('opus') on every session_start, burning expensive tokens even for simple tasks. See extensions/model-budget.ts.
pi-kit offline-driver KNOWN_MODELS context windows corrected: nemotron-3-nano:30b→1048576, devstral-small-2:24b→393216, qwen3:30b→262144. See extensions/offline-driver.ts.
pi-kit status-bar context fill bar color fixed: normal state now uses 'muted' (informational gray) instead of 'success' (vomit green). Committed in 774a1eb.
pi-kit style.ts SIGNALS.green and SKILL.md now both use #34d399 (theme ground truth from default.json). #3daa8e was phantom value. Fixed in 774a1eb.
pi-kit skill files (skills/*/SKILL.md) are loaded on-demand by the agent when task matches. Covers git, python, oci, rust, style, cleave conventions.

pi-kit status-bar uses leading indicator thresholds: <45% muted, 45-70% warning, >70% error — these lead the pressure gradient (55-75%) and auto-compact (85%) so the user sees state changes before the system reacts. See extensions/status-bar.ts.

title: Fixed npm-global PATH priority over Homebrew in dotfiles
narrative: The goal was to make the npm-globally-installed `pi` CLI (v0.56.0) take precedence over the Homebrew-installed version (v0.55.4). The initial fix placed the PATH entry in `.bashrc`, but this failed because login shells (bash -l) skip non-interactive guard blocks in `.bashrc`. The fix was moved to `.bash_profile` where it runs unconditionally for login shells, prepending `$HOME/.npm-global/bin` before Homebrew entries. After re-stowing the dotfiles, a fresh login shell correctly resolves `pi` to the npm-global version.

title: Fixed green token mismatch and offline model metadata
narrative: The goal was to resolve a color token inconsistency where `style.ts` and `SKILL.md` declared green as `#3daa8e` while the ground-truth `themes/default.json` used `#34d399`. Both files were updated to match the theme, and a grep confirmed no stale references remained. Two related fixes were bundled into the same commit: the status bar context-fill color was changed from `success` (garish green at normal levels) to `muted` (subdued gray-green), and offline model context window values in `offline-driver.ts` were corrected from a universal 128K to their actual sizes (Nemotron 1M, Devstral 384K, Qwen3 256K). All 497 tests passed and the commit was pushed to main. No open threads remain.

title: Tuned status bar to predictively lead compaction thresholds
narrative: The goal was to make the pi-kit status bar a predictive indicator rather than a mirror of the compaction system. Initially the bar thresholds were aligned 1:1 with compaction boundaries (65/85%), but the user wanted to see warnings before pressure and compaction events actually occur. The pressure gradient was also lowered from 40-65% to 55-75%. Bar thresholds were set to lead the pressure system by ~10%: yellow at 45% (10% before pressure onset at 55%) and red at 70% (15% before auto-compaction at 85%). All tests passed and changes were committed and pushed to main.

title: Tuned context bar and pressure gradient thresholds
narrative: The goal was to make the status bar a predictive visual indicator rather than mirroring the compaction system's own thresholds. Initially the bar colors were aligned 1:1 with compaction thresholds (65/85%), but the user wanted yellow and red to appear before the agent feels pressure—giving advance notice. The pressure gradient onset was also lowered from 40% to 55% and warning from 65% to 75% so the agent gets warned earlier. Final bar thresholds were set to 45% (yellow) and 70% (red), leading the pressure onset (55%) and auto-compact (85%) by ~10% each. All tests passed and changes were committed and pushed to main.
